subject: Final go/no-go: MAP checklist, signature window & start-date contingency
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightcart.com>, Tarun Rao <tarun@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Final go/no-go: MAP checklist, signature window & start-date contingency

Emily / Tarun —

Thanks for the productive evaluation run this month. Per our last call, I've attached the updated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a tidy SOW draft (SOW_BrightCart_v1.2.pdf) that aligns milestones with your pilot dates. Key asks from our side to get to papers and launch: 

- Confirm signatory authority and earliest signature window (we can do DocuSign or eSign through procurement)
- Procurement payment terms (PO vs. net-30 vs net-45) — if procurement needs a form, Monica can support
- Target start date for the production ramp or pilot (we've penciled Oct 18)

High-level plan: if signatures are completed by Oct 6 we can onboard into a 2-week pilot and scale to full rollout on Oct 18. If legal or procurement needs extra review, please flag exact blockers and expected clearance date so we can adjust the workplan.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP checklist + owners), SOW_BrightCart_v1.2.pdf (redlines accepted in blue)

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightcart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Tarun Rao <tarun@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: MAP checklist, signature window & start-date contingency

Thanks Sean — quick follow-up from procurement side.

1) Attached our procurement intake (Procurement_Form_BC.pdf). Our AP team needs the contract value broken out by quarter and vendor W-9 on file.
2) Who is the legal owner for the SOW redlines? We saw a few comments in v1.2 we want to confirm (data handling / retention and audit log SLA).
3) Signature authority: CFO signs >$250k. Tarun will confirm whether the current quotes place us above that threshold. If so, CFO availability impacts our earliest sign-by date.

We can turn around the procurement form within 48 hours once you provide the quarter-by-quarter split and W-9. I attached the procurement form for your ops team to review.

Best,
Emily
Head of Product Ops | BrightCart
emily.chen@brightcart.com

Emily / Tarun —

Thanks for the note, Emily. Quick answers and next steps from legal/ops: 

- W-9: Monica, can you attach our W-9 to the thread?
- Quarter split: Sean, included below is a suggested FQ4/Q1 split in the attached SOW_BrightCart_v1.2.pdf (page 2). If that works for BrightCart procurement we can convert to a DocuSign-ready agreement tonight.
- Data handling & retention: we added a short appendix clarifying retention default (90 days) and audit log export cadence; if BrightCart requires longer retention we can include an addendum and note potential cost delta.
- Signature authority / timing: if CFO sign required, please flag the earliest availability window. If CFO is unavailable next week we can optionally provisionally route for VP-level signature with a CFO affirmation within 30 days (internal escalation path).

Proposed cadence to close: 
1) BrightCart returns procurement form + PO or sign-by date by 2027-09-27
2) Redwood sends DocuSign packet (final SOW + MAP appendix) by 2027-09-28
3) Signatures complete by 2027-10-06 -> Pilot kickoff week of 2027-10-18

If any of those milestone dates drift, call out which one and we will update the MAP and onboarding calendar.

Attachments: SOW_BrightCart_v1.2.pdf (final edits + quarter split); Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx referenced

Regards,
Kimberly Park
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Tarun Rao <tarun@brightcart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-27T15:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: MAP checklist, signature window & start-date contingency

Team —

Quick alignment from our side after checking with finance: 

- Procurement: we will complete and return the procurement intake by EOD 2027-09-28.
- CFO availability: CFO is out the week of Sep 28 — earliest CFO signature window is the week of Oct 4 (preferred Oct 6). If the total contract is >$250k she will need to sign.
- Start date: we want production pilot to begin Oct 18; given the CFO timing that still works for us if we can get the DocuSign packet by Sep 30.
- SLA: Need clarity on audit log export (frequency) and a 30-day rollback option in SOW (to protect our peak-week ops). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide weekly CSV export + a rollback clause?

If you can push the DocuSign link by Sep 30 and include the W-9 on file, we can get signatures back by Oct 6 and be ready for an Oct 18 pilot.

Thanks —
Tarun Rao
Director, Data Platforms | BrightCart
tarun@brightcart.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tarun Rao <tarun@brightcart.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: MAP checklist, signature window & start-date contingency

Tarun / Emily —

Great — thanks for the clarity. Summary and commitments from Redwood: 

- DocuSign packet: Kimberly & I will finalize the SOW and MAP appendix and send DocuSign by 2027-09-30 EOD. Packet will include the W-9 and the quarter-by-quarter price list.
- Audit logs / rollback: Redwood can provide weekly CSV audit exports and we will include a 30-day rollback clause in the SOW appendix for the pilot period. I noted the checkbox in the MAP (row 7).
- Signature window: we will route for CFO signature with the option to accept a VP-level signature followed by CFO affirmation within 30 days if BrightCart prefers faster provisioning.
- Pilot kickoff: targeting the week of 2027-10-18; onboarding calendar will be updated once DocuSign completes.

Monica — can you attach the W-9 and drop the DocuSign support note into the packet?

If all good on your end I will mark the MAP milestone "signatures pending" and send the packet tomorrow.

Thanks and looking forward to kickoff —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: SOW_BrightCart_v1.2.pdf, Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx, W-9 (attached by Redwood ops)
